statement:
The moderation record gives the court-ruling value as “lifted,” which would ordinarily indicate restoration.
Post P-88 remains taken down, as required by the court order currently in force.
judge_text:
WRONG

It flags the record's value as conflicting with the stated in-force order ("gives the court-ruling value as 'lifted,' which would ordinarily indicate restoration" yet "remains taken down, as required by the court order currently in force").
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
